summary: Iteration 2: tested the 10 new listing categories, the partner (Empresas parceiras) flow from start to finish, the assistant stack screen, and a regression pass. Backend: 52/52 pytest pass (new test_partners_categories.py + updated test_mercadolocal.py). Frontend (375x667 web preview), all checks pass: home chips (10 categories + Todos, scrolling sideways, Aluguel filter); Assistente IA button opens /assistant with a back button, and streaming chat works; the 4 tabs Início/Serviços/Anunciar/Conta; Serviços list, 11 service chips, filter, search and WhatsApp button (opens api.whatsapp.com with prefilled text); Cadastrar while logged out goes to /login; Cadastrar while logged in opens /partner-form, which is prefilled from the profile, shows validation errors and submits; Conta then shows 'Aguardando aprovação'; admin Parceiros tab shows the pending partner and the stats; Aprovar makes the partner appear in Serviços; Recusar works; Delete opens a confirm modal, and both Cancel and Remover work; Anunciar shows the 10 categories; register, listing-detail WhatsApp and the admin Anúncios/Usuários tabs still work. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: whatsapp is checked only as min_length=8 chars (letters allowed). The frontend requires at least 10 digits. The backend should strip non-digits and require 10-13 digits, as the frontend does.

Upsert resets an approved partner to pending even when nothing changed, so the partner disappears from Serviços until the admin approves again. This may be intended; consider showing a warning in the form.

ui_bugs.issue: send() returns silently when `session` is not yet loaded from async storage (line 43: `if (!t || busy || !session) return`). On the first test run, sending right after the screen opened did nothing and showed no feedback. It worked after a ~2s wait. Disable the send button until the session is ready, or create the session id synchronously and persist it afterwards.

integration_issues.issue: After login the user lands on home '/' instead of returning to /partner-form. Pass a redirect param to login, or use router.replace('/partner-form') after login.

issues: The 5-column category grid uses very small labels (~11px). 'Eletrodomésticos' and 'Casas à venda' wrap or squeeze at 375px width. Consider 2-3 columns or a horizontal scroll.
A black browser focus outline shows inside the rounded search box on web. Add outlineStyle:'none' (web only) to the TextInput style.
Markdown list syntax ('- item') is shown as raw text in assistant bubbles (cosmetic).

action_items: Assistant: block or disable send until the session is ready (assistant.tsx:43)
Return the user to /partner-form after logging in from Serviços > Cadastrar
Backend: check partner whatsapp digits (10-13 digits), matching the frontend
Optional: admin stats category grid readability; web outline on the search input
critical_code_review_comments: services.tsx: the partners query refetches on every keystroke (queryKey includes q). Add a debounce of ~300ms.
server.py is 676 lines, close to the 700-line limit. Consider splitting the partners/admin/AI routers into modules.
admin_partner_status: find_one_and_update with return_document=True works (pymongo treats True as AFTER). Using ReturnDocument.AFTER would be clearer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flows; 1 low-priority race + 1 redirect UX issue

Remaining partners are not test data: 'Carlos Eduardo da Silva lima' (approved) and 'Zé Auto Center' (rejected). The listings collection is now empty (0 listings). The admin password was not changed (admin123).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env; pytest tests/test_partners_categories.py tests/test_mercadolocal.py; then python tests/cleanup_test_data.py. Admin delete/reject actions use the confirm-dialog-confirm/cancel testIDs. On /assistant, wait ~2s before sending (session race). Tabs have no testIDs; use get_by_text('Serviços').
rca_of_issue: Chat send no-op: the session id is loaded asynchronously in useEffect (storage.getItem), and send() returns early while session is still ''. Reproduce: open /assistant and send immediately. Fix: disable the send button while !session, or compute the sid synchronously.
